answer: A bond must be split across 4 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Because each wharf escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the lagoon ledger records every share and the basalt audit reveals the split. Assembling that for 67 aliases means 67 times 4 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code.
